description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares four pure virtual functions intended to handle various events related to runtime management, window management, ripple events, and state change events, all passing JsonObject data structures.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Plugin::IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class that declares callback methods for handling different types of events, each accepting specific parameters including JsonObjects and strings.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, receiving a JsonObject with event data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, receiving a JsonObject with event data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events identified by a string name and accompanying event data in a JsonObject.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, receiving a JsonObject with event data.
